Goals

  • Decide if we should switch to GitHub Actions as default pipeline

Rationale for decision is that we (DevOps team) only want to maintain one implementation of default pipeline that fulfil our needs. The more product teams that use same setup the easier to collaborate. Align with Inter IKEA goals for tools platform.

Decisions

Background (also see topics above):

Most IPEX teams that have migrated to GitHub have implemented pipeline using GitHub Actions.

Inter IKEA platform will most likely be based on GitHub Actions.

Microsoft is investing heavily in development of GitHub Actions and is promoting usage of GitHub Actions for CI CD implementation e.g. MyBuild - Increase Developer Velocity with Microsoft’s end-to-end developer platform 10:30 - 18:00

Since we are only using Azure Pipelines and Azure Artifacts today we have already missed a lot of the integrated environment that is Azure DevOps strength so impact of changing to GitHub Actions is not large. Integration to Azure Artifacts from GitHub Actions is solved.

Pipeline is moving closer to the code which means some integrations is easier e.g. removal of PR environment if PR is closed.

GitHub Actions and workflows are not at mature as Azure Pipelines but we have yet not discovered any missing functionality that is show stopper.
